contract.interface: A site-time has one shared category: Haar with probability s>0, known residual with probability r, or gate otherwise. Same-level dependence is affine over F_q and deterministic forcing uses strictly lower levels only. A batch of m requested coordinates may be at specified times; c is finite depth and each site has at most k parents.
